question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The divide between the upper class and the lower class is __jixtaposed__ in this play.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Juxtaposed"** means to place or deal with close together for contrasting effect. (समीप रखकर तुलना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The artist **juxtaposed **the vibrant colors to create a dramatic effect.
 
 
 
• **Jixtaposed** is a misspelling of the word "Juxtaposed". (गलत वर्तनी)
 
 
• **Example: **The divide between the upper class and the lower class is jixtaposed in this play.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Juxtapused** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of "Juxtaposed".

 
 
• **Example:** The word "Juxtapused" is not recognized in English.
 
 
 
• **Juxtapoised** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of "Juxtaposed".
 
 
• **Example:** The word "Juxtapoised" is not recognized in English.
 
 
 
• **Jextaposed** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of "Juxtaposed".
 
 
• **Example:** The word "Jextaposed" is not recognized in English.
